# Motor protection inputs
## Nameplate
Obtain motor nameplate current, supply voltage, phase count, duty, power factor and efficiency where a calculation is needed.

## Protection system
Identify starting method, inrush, overload and short-circuit protection, cable conditions and prospective fault current. Use actual manufacturer coordination tables for a documented device combination. This checklist is not a specification or compliance determination.
